item.title: Mexico detains top cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro,' setting off violence
item.description: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, better known as "El Chapo Isidro," was one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives. His arrest in northwest Mexico on Saturday has sparked violence in the region.

item.title: Killer robots: U.N. talks fall short of hopes for legally binding rules
item.description: U.N. talks in Geneva have failed to deliver binding rules on autonomous weapons, as humanitarian groups warn that military AI is advancing far faster than diplomacy.

item.title: Military analyst Phillips O'Brien on Ukraine and Europe being left out of Trump's talks
item.description: As President Trump met with Russian and Chinese counterparts, Ukraine and its European allies were left out of the talks. NPR's Scott Simon talks with Phillips O'Brien of St. Andrew's University.

item.title: Anthropic worker claims to have solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of AI
item.description: A mathematician who works for artificial intelligence giant Anthropic claims he has solved a Holy Grail of math problems with the help of the company's AI tool Claude. It marks the second time in recent months that an AI company or someone linked to one claims to have cracked a famed unsolved math problem.

item.title: Nations at UN talks on AI killer robots agree to more talks but no firm commitment to rein them in
item.description: Efforts to establish rules for AI-powered killer robots and drones have run aground. U.N.-backed talks in Geneva ended Saturday with an agreement to extend discussions for two more years.

item.title: Another day of survival for a family in Ukraine
item.description: On the outskirts of Kyiv, one family prepares for the fifth winter of war against Russia -- stockpiling food and fuel and trying to maintain as much a sense of normalcy as possible.

item.title: The U.K. and EU hold a rare summit to strengthen ties
item.description: A decade after the people of Britain voted to leave the European Union, top EU officials are meeting with Prime Minister Andy Burnham on Friday, looking to mend more fences.
